## Description

Finds all `*manifest*sha256*` files in the repository and compares the two most recent ones (by modification time) with `tools/compare_manifests.py`, to show what changed since the last ingest, for example in a revision. With fewer than two manifests, it writes a placeholder saying no comparison is available.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/22_compare_manifests.sh [project_id]
```

`project_id` is accepted but not used.

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.

## Outputs

- `generated/manifest-comparison.md` - Full comparison
- `generated/manifest-cmp-summary.md` - Short summary
